author: L. Okonkwo (Safety)
body:
INCIDENT REPORT INC-2025-00417 — ACCIDENT (severity 3)
Hub: HUB-CHI (Chicago). Vehicle VEH-0015, driver DRV-01017, route RTE-CHI-20250115-201.

SUMMARY
During the Jan 14-16 winter storm, a semi jackknifed on an icy on-ramp departing the Chicago hub. No injuries. Trailer load secured and recovered; the affected shipment is recorded on this report.

TIMELINE
- 2025-01-15 08:40 loss of traction on ramp incline; unit jackknifed.
- 08:52 driver reported in; area coned, no secondary collision.
- 10:20 recovery unit on scene; trailer offloaded to a spare.

ROOT CAUSE
Unsalted ramp and reduced traction during active snowfall exceeded safe dispatch conditions. Contributing factor: aggressive storm-recovery scheduling.

REMEDIATION
Unit pulled for inspection (see linked work order). Dispatch hold instituted for CHI when ramp conditions fall below threshold. Reviewed with dispatch.

author: Alicia Munro
body:
POSTMORTEM INC-2025-02233 — MISPICK (severity 3)
Hub: HUB-IND (Indianapolis). Author: Alicia Munro (ops lead).

SUMMARY
A cluster of wrong-delivery complaints the week of May 12 was traced to a single root cause. A representative affected order is linked on this report; the full set was intercepted and corrected.

TIMELINE
- 05/12 first wrong-delivery ticket received.
- 05/13 pattern recognized across clients; incident opened.
- 05/14-16 remaining mis-picks intercepted and corrected.

ROOT CAUSE
A pick bin was relabeled during a reslot but the label did not match the WMS location. High-volume pickers pulled from the mislabeled bin, sending the wrong SKUs to multiple clients.

PROCESS CHANGE
Mandatory scan-to-confirm bin ID at pick; no manual label overrides; a weekly bin-label audit. Rolled out to all IND pickers via training (see HR training records referencing INC-2025-02233).
